  pub trait Sealed {} } /// A sealed compile-time marker for exactly one [`DataType`] variant. /// /// Marker implementations validate the variant only. Parameters such as a /// decimal precision, timestamp unit, or list child remain in the wrapped /// [`Field`], so the typed view never duplicates schema state.
